title: Selective Next-Location Prediction with MetaModelSelect: A Lightweight Post-Hoc Confidence Metamodel
abstract: arXiv:2610.19394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Next-location prediction can support proactive mobile-network decisions, but acting on unreliable predictions can waste resources. We apply MetaModelSelect, a lightweight post-hoc confidence metamodel, to selective cellular next-location prediction. The mobility-specific model combines a learned embedding of the predicted location with the four largest softmax probabilities and Softmax Concentration. It learns whether a frozen recurrent neural network's top-1 prediction is correct, using only its outputs and without retraining the backbone. On path-balanced Changchun cellular mobility trajectories, we evaluate backbones trained with cross-entropy (CE) and self-adaptive training plus entropy minimization (SAT+EM), comparing against eight scalar confidence scores, two location-aware lookup methods, and a raw-logit multilayer perceptron. translated_title: 基于MetaModelSelect的选择性下一位置预测：一种轻量级事后置信度元模型
translated_abstract: 下一位置预测可以支持主动式的移动网络决策，但基于不可靠的预测采取行动可能会浪费资源。我们将MetaModelSelect——一种轻量级的事后置信度元模型——应用于选择性蜂窝网络下一位置预测。该面向移动性场景的模型将预测位置的习得嵌入与四个最大的softmax概率以及Softmax集中度相结合。它仅利用冻结的循环神经网络的输出，无需重新训练骨干网络，即可学习该网络的top-1预测是否正确。在路径平衡的长春蜂窝移动轨迹数据上，我们评估了采用交叉熵（CE）训练以及采用自适应训练加熵最小化（SAT+EM）训练的骨干网络，并与八种标量置信度分数、两种位置感知查找方法以及一个原始logit多层感知机进行比较。相对于最大softmax概率，MetaModelSelect在每次运行的曲线下面积方面实现了平均降低（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出轻量级事后置信度元模型MetaModelSelect，无需重训冻结的循环神经网络骨干即可判断其下一位置预测是否可靠，从而实现选择性蜂窝网络下一位置预测并减少资源浪费。
en_tdlr: MetaModelSelect is a lightweight post-hoc confidence metamodel that judges whether a frozen RNN's top-1 next-location prediction is correct without retraining the backbone, enabling resource-efficient selective cellular next-location prediction.
